name: Kvens
description: A blue field charged at the centre with a white-ringed red disc bearing a golden eight-spoked sun wheel.
history: The Kven flag bears the aurinkopyörä (sun wheel), an ancient northern solar symbol, for the Kven people — descendants of Finnish-speaking migrants to northern Norway. It came into common use among Kven organizations in the 2010s and is flown on Kven People's Day (16 March).
